title: Esterification Reaction
text: Esterification is a condensation reaction between a carboxylic acid and an alcohol. The -OH from the acid combines with the -H from the alcohol to form water.

title: The Ester Functional Group
text: Esters contain the -COO- functional group. They are formed when the -COOH group of the acid joins with the -OH group of the alcohol, releasing H$$_2$$O.

title: Reaction Summary
text: Carboxylic acid + Alcohol --> Ester + Water (in presence of H$$_2$$SO$$_4$$ catalyst and heat)
